mechanism: Echinacea may induce CYP1A2 and CYP3A4 enzymes, potentially reducing ciprofloxacin plasma concentrations and efficacy, while also possessing immunostimulatory properties that could theoretically interfere with antibiotic action.
action: Monitor clinical response to ciprofloxacin therapy; consider spacing administration or using alternative antimicrobial if therapeutic failure occurs, and counsel patients to avoid concurrent use when possible.
